customer.vertical: custom apparel decoration / quote-based service SME

golden_evidence_cards.direct_observation: Page describes methods (spot color, four-color process, simulated process, specialty printing) but shows the heading and method names repeatedly across the page; page does not state any minimum order quantity, any price range, any per-piece price, or any turnaround time anywhere in the visible text. CTA is the global 'Get a Quote' nav link.
golden_evidence_cards.buyer_question: How many pieces must I order and roughly what will screen printing cost me before I contact you?
golden_evidence_cards.specific_gap: No minimum-order, price, or turnaround information on the screen-printing service page, so a comparison-minded buyer cannot pre-qualify their order.
golden_evidence_cards.business_mechanism: The buyer question 'minimums + price' is a pre-sales qualification step; a page that omits it forces every visitor to submit a quote form before they can even self-qualify, which filters out smaller or price-sensitive buyers and lowers the pool of qualified enquiries that reach the goal (more sales-revenue).
golden_evidence_cards.recommended_module: Add a 'Pricing & Minimums' section to this exact screen-printing page

implementation_brief.owner_confirmation_required: OWNER CONFIRMATION REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLICATION: every MOQ number, price factor, per-color setup fee and turnaround day must be confirmed by the Apple Imprints owner/Sales before any of the copy below is published. The following is candidate copy only, NOT confirmed fact.

candidate_copy_for_owner_approval.moq_candidate: Screen printing starts at a minimum of 24 pieces per design. (CONFIRM actual MOQ with owner.)
candidate_copy_for_owner_approval.price_factors_candidate: List the four price factors: quantity, ink colors, print locations, blank garment cost. (CONFIRM.)
candidate_copy_for_owner_approval.setup_fee_candidate: A one-time screen setup fee applies per color and is amortized over the run; reorders reuse stored screens at lower cost. (CONFIRM fee.)
candidate_copy_for_owner_approval.turnaround_candidate: Typical production 1-2 weeks after art approval; rush available by phone. (CONFIRM window.)

implementation_brief.exact_module_placement: Insert a 'Pricing & Minimums' block immediately after the 'Specialty Printing' method list and before the final 'Get a Quote' CTA, on the screen-printing service page.
implementation_brief.approval_dependency: Sales/Operations must approve the exact MOQ, per-color setup fee, and turnaround window before publish. Do NOT commit any specific number that is unconfirmed.
implementation_brief.exact_quote_cta_destination: https://appleimprints.com/get-a-quote-2/ (existing quote form) with text 'Get an exact quote'.
implementation_brief.qa: Verify on mobile (form stacks) and desktop (pricing table does not overflow) after publish.
implementation_brief.baseline_metrics: Record quote-form submissions and session count on this exact page for 14 business days before the change.
implementation_brief.scale_rule: Only after two positive 30-day review points (quote submissions up on this page) extend the same 'Pricing & Minimums' module to embroidery and DTG pages. Not site-wide before this page proves it.

golden_evidence_cards.evidence: Direct page read on 2026-09-13 (headings + body verified; no price/minimum/turnaround tokens present).

golden_evidence_cards.direct_observation: Quote form is present ('First Name * Last Name * Email Address * Phone') with the line 'Within 24 hours or less! If rush is needed, please call us!' There is no statement describing what happens after submission, no reference to any past work/proof, and no expectation-setting about the next step, pricing, or samples.
golden_evidence_cards.buyer_question: After I submit this form, what happens next and why should I trust Apple Imprints to do my order?
golden_evidence_cards.specific_gap: Quote page collects contact details but gives no post-submission expectation, no proof/reference, and no reason for a wary first-time buyer to trust a small shop.
golden_evidence_cards.business_mechanism: Trust is a decision-stage blocker for a small, lesser-known decorator; a quote page that sends no trust signal makes hesitant first-time buyers more likely to abandon rather than submit the form, directly suppressing quote submissions that drive the goal (more sales-revenue).
golden_evidence_cards.recommended_module: Add a 'What happens next' 3-step trust/process explainer with a proof link, under the quote form

implementation_brief.owner_confirmation_required: OWNER CONFIRMATION REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLICATION: the stated response-time ('one business day') and any service promise must be approved by the owner/service manager. The three steps below are proposa, not confirmed SLA copy.
exact_three_steps: Step 1 — 'We review your order within one business day.'
Step 2 — 'We reply with an exact quote, a proof, and a timeline for your design.'
Step 3 — 'Approve the proof and we start production; rush is available by phone.'
implementation_brief.exact_trust_proof_route: Link the words 'completed orders' to https://appleimprints.com/gallery/ as visible proof.
implementation_brief.exact_module_placement: Render the 3-step explainer BELOW the quote form fields and ABOVE the 'Within 24 hours' line, so it does not push the form off the first screen on mobile.
implementation_brief.approval_who: The 'one business day' response-time claim must be approved by the owner/service manager before publish; do not restate an unconfirmed SLA.
implementation_brief.qa: Mobile: form fields remain above the fold; Desktop: 3-step block renders inline without overflow; proof link opens /gallery/.
implementation_brief.baseline_metrics: Record form-start and form-submit rate for 14 business days before the change.
implementation_brief.scale_rule: Only after two positive 30-day review points (submit rate up) extend the same trust/expectation block to the contact page and about page. Not site-wide before the quote page proves it.

golden_evidence_cards.evidence: Direct page read on 2026-09-13 (form fields + 'Within 24 hours or less!' string verified).

golden_evidence_cards.direct_observation: Gallery page exists with heading 'Our Works' and text 'browse our gallery of completed orders that have satisfied...' but it is a single image wall with no captions, no per-item service/technique tag, no link back to the matching service pages, and no testimonial text or case detail.
golden_evidence_cards.buyer_question: Which of these pieces were done with screen printing vs embroidery, and can I see a completed example of my specific project type?
golden_evidence_cards.specific_gap: Gallery images are unlabelled so a decoration buyer cannot map a completed piece to the service they are considering, and the page does not feed the relevant service page or quote page.
golden_evidence_cards.business_mechanism: Proof works only if a buyer can connect it to their intended service; unlabelled, un-linked gallery images do not build that connection, so the trust/proof asset fails to move evaluation-stage buyers toward the quote, limiting the goal (more sales-revenue).
golden_evidence_cards.recommended_module: Add captions/technique tags to the first 12 priority gallery items and link each to its service page and the quote form

implementation_brief.owner_confirmation_required: OWNER CONFIRMATION REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLICATION: the content owner and the production lead must verify each item's actual technique before any tag is published.
implementation_brief.caption_taxonomy: Tag every captioned item with a technique from the service list — screen-printing / embroidery / DTG / DTF / debossing — plus item type (t-shirt / polo / hoodie / hat / tote).
implementation_brief.technique_service_mapping: screen-printing via /screen-printing/; embroidery via /embroidery/; DTG via /directo-to-garment-dtg/; DTF via /direct-to-film-dtf/; debossing via /debossing/.
implementation_brief.exact_module_placement: On the gallery page, add a caption + technique tag under each of the first 12 priority images and a 'Get a quote for a similar piece' link; each caption links to the matching service page and to the quote form.
implementation_brief.exact_quote_cta_destination: https://appleimprints.com/get-a-quote-2/ ('Get a quote for a similar piece').
implementation_brief.approval_dependency: Content owner writes captions; production lead (service owner) confirms each item's actual technique before the tag is published.
implementation_brief.qa: Mobile + desktop: captions wrap, links resolve, images do not reflow; every tagged item links to the correct service page and quote route.
implementation_brief.baseline_metrics: Record gallery-to-quote link clicks and session count on the gallery page for 14 business days before the change.
implementation_brief.scale_rule: Only after two positive 30-day review points (quote-link clicks up) extend tagging to the next 12 items. Do not tag the full gallery at once.

golden_evidence_cards.evidence: Direct page read on 2026-09-13 (heading + body verified; no captions/links/tags present).
